correctness.rationale: For arbitrary fixed a,b satisfying (F∘tau^m)(an)=(F∘tau^m)(bn) for all n, fix any k and choose prime p outside the finite prime divisors of abk. Substituting n=k p^(r-1) for all r>=1 gives G(r tau(ak))=G(r tau(bk)), where G=F∘tau^(m-1). Inductive quasi-injectivity of G implies tau(ak)=tau(bk) for each k, and quasi-injectivity of tau gives a=b. Base m=0 is given. Theorem 15 of Pongsriiam supplies quasi-injectivity of Jordan-totient iterates. All quantifiers and multiplication identities are sound.
